modules.title: 芯片
modules.desc: 我们放上链的每颗芯片的真实版图：能放大、能看每块电路在做什么。每张图先和登记清单核对，一致了才显示。
modules.desc_en: The real layout of every chip we put on chain: zoom in and see what each block does. Each image is checked against its registered list before it shows. (The gallery is in Chinese.)

modules.title: 模型机
modules.desc: 一个玩具模型在浏览器里一个字节一个字节往外写，写出来还不通顺，不是故事。打开时自动核对，和链上记录对上了才运行。
modules.label: 每次写出的都和标准答案逐字节一致
modules.label_en: identical to the reference output, byte for byte, every time
modules.desc_en: A toy model runs in your browser and writes one byte at a time; the text is not fluent and not a story. Its files are checked against the chain first and only run if they match.

modules.title: NAND 玩 Squared
modules.desc: 链上的一块电路自己玩 11×11 小游戏。点「链上跑一步」才会联网，让区块链用同一个局面再算一次。
modules.label: 链上算的和你浏览器里算的完全一样
modules.label_en: the chain and your browser computed exactly the same moves
modules.desc_en: A circuit on chain plays an 11×11 game by itself. Only "Run one step on chain" goes online, asking the blockchain to compute the same move.

modules.title: 门电路大脑
modules.desc: 在你自己的电脑上向一个小 AI 提问，一问一答，回答和这个模型的整数参考实现一字不差，问题不离开你的电脑。用电脑上新版 Chrome 或 Edge（要 WebGPU）；第一次下载约 580 MB，以后不用再下；浏览器要占约 6 GB 内存；手机打不开。所以在新页面打开。
modules.label: 标准题的回答和整数参考实现逐字一致
modules.label_en: reference questions answered word for word like the integer reference implementation
modules.desc_en: Ask a small AI questions on your own computer, one at a time; its answers match this model's integer reference implementation word for word and your questions never leave your machine. Use a recent desktop Chrome or Edge (WebGPU); the first download is about 580 MB and is not repeated; the browser needs about 6 GB of memory; phones can't run it. That is why it opens in a new tab.

modules.title: 开车竞技场
modules.desc: 一辆只靠 21 个门开车的小车，在弯道上自己绕圈。点「开一圈」就开；想确认，可以让区块链也算一步。
modules.label: 固定起点全部跑完一圈
modules.label_en: every fixed start finishes a full lap
modules.desc_en: A car driven by just 21 gates laps a winding track by itself. Tap "Drive a lap"; to double-check, ask the blockchain to compute a step too.

modules.title: 吟游诗人
modules.desc: 一颗语言模型芯片的设计。现在这一版写儿童故事风格的英文句子，常不连贯、人物会乱，有时会出现 ⁇（模型不认识的词）。我们正在研究把它升级成能讲连贯故事的新芯片，还没做到。在浏览器里看它写，选 16 个词时用的整数规则和芯片相同；它的完整设计图存在 X Layer 上，可以取回并核对。
modules.tag_en: Writes sentences; fetch its chip design
modules.desc_en: A design for a language-model chip. This version writes English sentences in the style of children's stories. They often don't hang together, the characters get mixed up, and a ⁇ (a word the model doesn't know) sometimes appears. We are working on upgrading it into a chip that can tell a coherent story; it is not there yet. Watch it write in your browser; with the 16-word setting it uses the same integer rules as the chip; its full layout is stored on X Layer and can be fetched and verified.

modules.title: 自己核对
modules.desc: 挑本站任何一个文件，和链上记录比一比，确认它没被改过。
modules.label: 本站文件都登记在链上，下载下来逐字节一致
modules.label_en: every file on this site is recorded on chain and downloads byte for byte
modules.desc_en: Pick any file on this site and compare it with its on-chain record to confirm it has not been altered.

modules.title: 做电路
modules.desc: 做一个小电路，先在浏览器里把所有输入都试一遍，再用你的钱包写上链。只有这一步要用钱包，所以放在最后。
modules.label: 我们放上链的一个计算电路，谁都能查到
modules.label_en: a computing circuit we put on chain; anyone can look it up
modules.desc_en: Make a small circuit, test every input in your browser, then write it on chain with your wallet. This is the only step that needs a wallet, so it comes last.

modules.title: 文档
modules.desc: 每个模块怎么用、怎么自己核对，技术细节都在这里。
modules.desc_en: How each module works and how to check it yourself.
